insights.one_liner: MG Motor Europe is the Amsterdam-based European arm of car brand MG, owned by China's SAIC Motor; it is not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: MG traces back to Morris Garages in 1924 and is now owned by SAIC Motor, which it calls the world's 7th largest carmaker.

open.text: MG Motor Europe is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a mid-level finance role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch but drew about 200 LinkedIn applicants.

growth.text: Parent SAIC Motor was the first Chinese car group to sell more than 7 million vehicles a year.
